topic_thesis: Finance gurus use dramatic Fed rate predictions and market turning point panic purely as bait to harvest referral commissions from broker account signups.
strategic_angle: Expose the affiliate arbitrage loop where YouTubers earn ₹300-₹700 per demat account signup plus brokerage revenue shares, making their referral links infinitely more profitable than their actual stock market analysis.
target_emotion: Betrayal and cynical awakening toward online trading gurus
